Separate calculations from the entry point

Put calculations and data transformations in importable functions. A main() function handles workflow, messages, and inputs. The __name__ guard runs main only when the file is launched as the top-level program.

def total(values):
    return sum(values)

def main():
    print(total([2, 3]))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
Example output
5

Record the environment

Use a virtual environment per project. Record the Python version and dependencies so colleagues can reproduce the run. A requirements file can pin an application environment, and pyproject.toml can declare project metadata and dependency requirements for packaging.

python -m pip freeze > requirements.txt
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
